rows.grounds: compound of pratīti (appearance/cognition), mātra (mere/only), and emphatic eva
locative adverb referring to the present context
abstract noun from dvandva bandha-mokṣa with -tā suffix

items.question: What constitutes the true ontological status of bondage and liberation in this context?
premises: Bondage and liberation were previously characterized as forms of ignorance.
Their presence here is qualified as mere appearance only.
Their status is limited to that extent alone.
items.inference: Therefore, bondage and liberation have no reality beyond being mere appearances.
uncertainties: Whether pratīti emphasizes subjective cognition or objective appearance is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Here, the state of bondage and liberation is only mere appearance, and nothing more than that.
